flags.why: Chúa thượng can address a king, so explicitly excluding the reigning king is false ([dictionary](https://api.vnjp.org/kanji/%E3%82%B7%E3%83%A7%E3%82%A6)).
flags.fix: Your Majesty; Your Highness (historical honorific addressing a king or ruling lord)

flags.why: This is an honorific for a human sovereign, whereas 'the Most High' denotes God ([dictionary](https://api.vnjp.org/kanji/%E3%82%B7%E3%83%A7%E3%82%A6)).
The insulting use in 'bọn đểu cáng' remains current and should not be marked dated ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/deu-cang-eQrjtNTEcrEby.html)).
